title: 2026 U.S. House of Representatives election for Montana's 2nd Congressional District
description: Montana's 2nd Congressional District covers eastern Montana, including Billings, Great Falls, and the Hi-Line. The general election on November 3, 2026, will determine who represents this safely Republican district in the U.S. House. Incumbent Republican Rep. Troy Downing, first elected in 2024, is seeking a second term. He faces Democratic nominee Brian Miller, a Helena attorney; Libertarian Patrick McCracken; and independent candidate Michael Eisenhauer, a cardiologist and retired Army colonel. The Cook Political Report rates the race as Solidly Republican.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of June 2026. The Cook Political Report rates MT-02 as 'Solidly Republican.'

candidates.name: Troy Downing
candidates.summary: Troy Downing is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Montana's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in 2024. He previously served as Montana State Auditor (2021–2025) and is a businessman, Air Force veteran, and former state auditor. Downing is running for a second term on a platform of conservative economic and national security policies.

candidates.name: Brian J Miller
candidates.summary: Brian Miller is a Helena attorney and the Democratic nominee for Montana's 2nd Congressional District. He won the June 2, 2026, Democratic primary with 55.5% of the vote. Miller is a partner at the law firm Morrison, Sherwood, Wilson & Deola, PLLP, and previously clerked for the Montana Supreme Court. His campaign focuses on healthcare, opposing corporate influence, and addressing missing and murdered Indigenous women.

candidates.name: Patrick McCracken
candidates.summary: Patrick McCracken is the Libertarian Party nominee for Montana's 2nd Congressional District. He ran unopposed in the June 2, 2026, Libertarian primary. His campaign focuses on monetary reform, price transparency in healthcare, country-of-origin labeling for beef, protecting Montana ratepayers from data center costs, and ending corporate cronyism.

candidates.name: Michael D Eisenhauer
candidates.summary: Michael Eisenhauer is an independent candidate for Montana's 2nd Congressional District. He is an interventional cardiologist and a retired U.S. Army Colonel who served nearly 25 years on active duty, including a deployment to Baghdad where he earned a Bronze Star. He is running as a pragmatic, nonpartisan alternative committed to healthcare access, fiscal discipline, and transparency in government.
